the-reed.title: The reed
the-reed.subtitle: “Man is only a reed, the weakest in nature, but he is a thinking reed." - Blaise Pascal, Pensées
the-reed.content:
For standing, reed of mine,
and strokes of morn sunlight,
O, must you stoop to blight?
Your kin, then, flames shall dine.



You jest, small reed of mine!
The oaks' rank, you desire?
Your seeds, then, I exchange,
For those with hemlock's bane.



Now what, tall reed of mine, 
courses suit someone your height?
So deadly, base, unsight,
An Eros hymn - you mayn't!



Your life unlived, my reed,
as noon confronts the weed.



19/7/23
